items.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent-prototype, a proactive coding agent that works one GitHub repo through issues and PRs
items.summary: DeepSeek published an MIT-licensed research prototype that runs on DeepSeek Harness, listens to GitHub (and optionally Feishu), opens a work item when an allowed user asks, works in its own session and answers with a pull request, with a web panel for things that need a person. It ships with an agent-guided SETUP.md and a design note on always-on router plus worker agents.

items.title: SenseTime releases SenseNova-Loop-9B-Preview, a looped multimodal model that runs 24 of 32 layers twice with shared weights
items.summary: Apache-2.0 open weights for a 9B text and image model that reuses a 24-layer block twice per forward pass (56 layer executions, about 14.6B inference parameters) with two-stream hyper-connections and hybrid linear/full attention, trained up to 256K context for agentic and long-document work. Benchmarks are vendor-run and the tech report is still listed as TBD.

doubt.pushback: Benchmark chart is vendor-run and the technical report is not out yet; no independent numbers.
